description: The video starts with the speaker talking. At 1.16s, a text overlay 'blister' appears on the screen. By 1.5s, the video transitions to an arm, and the previously mentioned text and a square outline highlighting a spot on the arm are visible. At 2.0s, the text updates to 'on a 3-YEAR OLD'. By 2.5s, the text further updates to 'on a 3-YEAR OLD GIRL'S ARM'. The image of the arm persists until 2.83s. At 2.83s, the scene changes back to the speaker, and a new image, which is a close-up of a scar with the text 'helped', appears at the top. The image at the top persists and the text changes to 'the' at 3.5s and then to 'smallpox' at 4.0s. The text 'smallpox' and the top image disappear at 4.29s.
description_orig: Historical painting with text overlay showing an arm with a smallpox vaccination mark and 'ON A 3-YEAR OLD'.
video_title: One tiny blister on her arm helped change India’s history!

description_orig: Split screen with an image of a smallpox scar on top and the speaking host at the bottom, with 'smallpox' text overlay.

description: The video transitions from the speaker to a series of black and white footage, typically framed within a smaller rectangular border, showing historical scenes related to vaccinations. The scenes depict medical professionals preparing vaccines, vaccinating children and adults, and crowds gathering for vaccinations. This footage is intermittently replaced with the speaker in the foreground.
description_orig: Historical black and white footage of vaccination efforts with text overlays 'vaccines', 'traveled', 'You know,', 'vaccine', and 'and use it'.
video_title: One tiny blister on her arm helped change India’s history!

description: The video transitions from a talking head to a series of archival black and white photos within a framed border, each accompanied by text overlays. The first photo shows a group of men, with 'convincing Indians' appearing as text. The second photo shows a man talking to a child, with 'vaccinated back then' as the text. The third photo shows a group of people, one holding a photo of a child, with 'was super difficult' appearing as text. The video then transitions back to the talking head.
description_orig: Historical black and white photos of people in India with text overlays 'Indians' and 'difficult'.
video_title: One tiny blister on her arm helped change India’s history!

description: The video transitions from a talking head to a series of black and white historical footage clips. First, a cow is shown, followed by a close-up of a person being vaccinated on the arm. The final clip shows an animation of the globe with many small figures descending onto it, as if parachuting or being spread across the world. The video then returns to the talking head.
description_orig: Historical black and white footage showing an inoculation, with text overlay 'from cowpox'.
video_title: One tiny blister on her arm helped change India’s history!

description: The video transitions from a talking head to a historical painting of a young girl with text appearing over her. The text changes to reveal a name, then a description of her age and location. Finally, the image changes to a historical illustration with text highlighting key information about vaccinations in India, including the date and the name Anna Dusthall, and then 'first' and 'in India'.
description_orig: Historical painting of a young girl standing in an outdoor setting, with text overlays 'Anna Dusthall' and 'in Bombay'.
